```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-vs-path
#| fig-cap: "CoordCube vs CoordPath on KV store"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

categories = ['CoordPath\nsequential 9-path', 'CoordCube\nproximity r=1', 'CoordCube\nproximity r=2']
values = [158, 285, 626]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.5))
bars = ax.bar(categories, values, width=0.5, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8,
              hatch=['', '///', '///'])

ax.set_ylabel('Latency (ns)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0, 750)

for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 12,
            f'{val} ns', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# Callout for the 127ns gap between first two bars
ax.annotate('127 ns\ngap', xy=(0.5, 222), fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
